name: primitives-texts-morphing

frames.best_why: Create and great products are both fully formed; earlier frames catch blurred letters mid-morph.

tagline: Letters blur, stretch and swap places until one phrase becomes another.
summary: A big looping headline that periodically changes word, with each letter fading and sliding into its new position, and a smaller supporting line morphing underneath.
appearance: A huge bold white word and a smaller grey line, both centred on a near-black stage. Mid-change the letters stretch, soften out of focus and briefly overlap as old glyphs leave and new ones enter.
behaviour: Every couple of seconds the pair of phrases advances: shared letters glide to their new spots while the rest blur out and back in. The cycle repeats without stopping and the small line is offset slightly in time.
demo_content: Cycles Animate, Delight, Inspire, Create above beautiful interfaces, smooth transitions, great products.
search_phrases: word changes with a blurry morph
letters rearrange into a new word
rotating words with a blur transition
use_when: A short rotating headline should draw the eye while the rest of the page stays still.
avoid_when: Long sentences or copy that must stay readable: the blur and endless loop make it hard to follow.
customise: The text array, hold time, loop flag and per-letter enter and exit variants are props; the morph layout itself is fixed in the source.
weight_why: One animated span per letter, and only the swapping word is in motion at a time.

a11y.note: Each phrase is exposed as one aria-label with the letters hidden, but motion ignores reduced-motion preferences.

polish_why: Letters morph cleanly and the type is crisp; mid-transition frames look messy by design.
title: Morphing Text
